summary: LCNB Corp. filed an 8-K announcing a private placement of $25 million aggregate principal amount of 6.50% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Subordinated Notes due 2036 to qualified institutional buyers and accredited investors under Section 4(a)(2) and Rule 506(b). The notes mature August 15, 2036, pay fixed 6.50% semi-annually until August 15, 2031, then float at SOFR plus 234 bps quarterly. Redeemable by the issuer after August 15, 2031, subject to regulatory approval; not redeemable by holders. Proceeds for general corporate purposes, including refinancing senior debt. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation.
